children: Shares of homeowners insurance company Porch Group were trading above recent 52-week highs after hours, following the company raising its full-year guidance.
After the bell, the company's shares were trading 21% higher, at $19.78.
Shares ended the day's regular session with a 7.7% loss, closing at $16.30. The stock previously hit a 52-week high of $18.75 on Oct. 21.
Porch said its 2026 Porch-Owned segments guidance, excluding reciprocal, called for revenue of $518 million to $523 million. Prior guidance anticipated a range of $506 million to $517 million.

For the quarter, the company reported earnings per share of 10 cents on revenue of $143.9 million. In the year-ago period, the company reported a loss per share of 10 cents on revenue of $115.1 million.
